department: School of Physical and Mathematical Sciences (SPMS) — Division of Mathematical Sciences

deadline.value: August 2027 intake deadline is January 31, 2027 (application period October to January; January intake June to July / closes July 31).

also.quote: There are two application periods each year: October to January (for admission in August), and June to July (for admission in January).

gre_subject.value: SPMS Mathematics PhD lists only general GRE/GATE (319 V+Q, 3.5 AW encouraged in FAQs) as optional and does not require the GRE Mathematics Subject Test.
gre_subject.quote: [Optional] GRE/GATE test scores - Demonstrating strong quantitative, verbal, or analytical skills through the submission of will enhance your application.

also.quote: A Graduate Record Examinations (GRE) test score of 319 (Verbal and Quantitative Reasoning) + 3.5 (Analytical Writing) and above is strongly encouraged.

supervisor.value: Unlike SPMS Physics, SPMS Mathematics does not require pre-admission supervisor sign-off, though SPMS FAQs advise contacting faculty before applying.
supervisor.quote: For PhD and MSc by research, contact the faculty member(s) you are interested in working with, and ask if they are interested in supervising you.

also.quote: It is highly recommended that you seek out a potential supervisor prior to submitting your application. Alternatively, if you have not identified one, the School will appoint a supervisor based on your research interests.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are eligible on a competitive basis for the NTU Research Scholarship (S$3,000/month for international students, plus up to S$500/month after passing the Qualifying Examination, and annual tuition fee coverage for up to 4 years; S$3,400 PR / S$3,800 Singapore Citizen), as well as the Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship and Provost Graduate Award (S$4,300/month international).
funding.quote: The NTU Research Scholarship is assigned by the School, and may be offered to applicants during the PhD programme application process (subject to limited availability).

also.quote: The NTU Research Scholarship is awarded to outstanding graduate students for research. | In addition to the monthly stipend, the award also covers the annual tuition fee.

entry_route.value: Direct PhD entry from a bachelor's degree in Mathematics or related discipline with minimum Honours (Distinction); an MSc is optional and not mandatory.
entry_route.quote: For the PhD programme, applicants may optionally have a MSc degree in Mathematics or a related discipline, but this is not mandatory.

notes: Division of Mathematical Sciences research covers Pure Mathematics, Coding and Cryptography, Computational Mathematics, and Applied Mathematics and Statistics. Note SPMS Scholarships page shows outdated RSS figures vs central January 2026 rates (S$3,000/month international).
